notes.subject: הפרטים
notes.rationale: 'to prattle/improvise idly on' (ASV 'sing idle songs', JPS 'thrum') vs KJV 'chant'; the verb can mean careless improvisation or plucking.

notes.subject: פי הנבל
notes.gloss: 'mouth of the nevel' — Hebrew idiom for the sound-hole/opening of the harp, rendered 'molomong wa nevele'.

notes.subject: כדויד
notes.rationale: 'like David' — praise (David invented instruments, Amos 6:5) or irony (they fancy themselves Davids); most read ironic here.

translation: Ba ho phadima molomong wa ⟨the⟩ nevele, ba ihlahloba jwalo ka Dawide, ba hlahisitse dibaka tsa kopelo bakeng sa bona.
